exercises.instruction: Match the words in each group that contain the same underlined vowel sound. The first one has been done for you.
items: Group 1: through, hot, enough, spoon, cough, trouble
Group 2: diet, machine, since, island, police, opposite
Group 3: accent, fast, potato, palace, calm, razor

exercises.instruction: In each line, underline the word which is stressed differently from the other three words.
items: Example: remember  decided  expensive  industry
1 symptom  sunbathe  palace  prefer
2 interested  understand  opposite  policy
3 cathedral  assistance  organise  remember
4 hyphen  police  decide  machine
5 accent  virus  machine  desert
6 advertisement  competition  psychology  grammatical

exercises.instruction: Choose the correct pronunciation and answer questions 1–9 using the phonetic symbols.
items: KNIFE /naif/ or /knaif/  AISLE /ail/ or /aisl/  HANDSOME /'hændsəm/ or /'hænsəm/
FASTEN /'fa:stən/ or /'fa:sən/  WRIST /wrist/ or /rist/  KNEE /kni:/ or /ni:/
BOMB /bomb/ or /bɒm/  HONEST /'hɒnist/ or /'ɒnist/  LISTEN /'listən/ or /'lisən/
CHRISTMAS /'krisməs/ or /'kristməs/
Example: You do this to music or the radio. ..../'lisən/..
1 This is between your hand and your arm. ..........................
2 This is where you walk on a plane to get to your seat. ..........................
3 If you are this, you tell the truth. ..........................
4 The joint in the middle of your leg. ..........................
5 If this explodes, it can be very dangerous. ..........................
6 You can describe an attractive-looking man as this. ..........................
7 You do this to your seat belt in a car or on a plane. ..........................
8 You need this for cutting your food. ..........................
9 A religious festival celebrated towards the end of December. ..........................

exercises.instruction: All the pictures are of words which contain the /ə/ sound at least once. Label the drawings and circle the (/ə/). Look at the example first.
items: Example: plum b(ə)r ..........

pictures: line drawing of a plumber at a sink (example: 'plumb(ə)r')
drawing of a cinema entrance with 'FILM SHOWING ALIEN' sign
